svg.title: Cross-Team Knowledge Relay High-Level Design Architecture
svg.desc: Clean numbered architecture diagram for Cross-Team Knowledge Relay.
svg.text: Clean system view with numbered lanes: user request, async matching, realtime notification, and failure fallback.
• Escrow service owns payout state machine
• Neo4j read replicas for match traffic
• Create bounty → validate at API → persist / emit event → worker queries Neo4j → publish match notification → frontend shows ranked cross-team experts → escrow resolves after consultation.
